summary: Master AI governance, strategic implementation, and ROI measurement. Executive-level AI strategies course for competitive advantage and transformation.
lede: AI strategy equips senior leaders to assess where AI fits business priorities and plan adoption across an organization. Participants practice assessing organizational readiness, prioritizing use cases by value and feasibility, and developing governance and implementation plans with vendor criteria, accountability, and performance measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior leaders who must make strategic decisions about AI adoption, investment prioritization, and organizational transformation.
modules: AI Strategic Foundation and Competitive Context
AI Governance and Risk Management Frameworks
Strategic Use Case Identification and Prioritization
AI Solution Architecture and Technology Strategy
AI Vendor Evaluation and Partnership Strategy
AI Implementation Planning and Change Management
AI Performance Measurement and ROI Tracking
AI Strategy Communication and Stakeholder Engagement
prerequisites: This course is designed for senior executives and requires no technical AI background. Participants should bring current strategic challenges and organizational context to maximize learning application. Recommended preparation includes reviewing your organization's current technology investments and strategic planning priorities.
